column1: # Mario Kart World (Switch 2, update v917504 = 1.8.0). In bring-up
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive), SDK 21.4.0, NVN2 (the Switch 2's NVN); modules main + subsdk0 (movie) + subsdk1 (libc) + sdk.
# Packed from a dump folder (base/, updates/<version>/) with scripts/pack_dump.py. Shaders: Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs (BNSH, Nin_Ounce_NVN2).
# the program ID in the update's main.npdm (ACI0), the same as the base title ID
# a 3D game: the 3D layout (a D-pad and a right stick), as Donkey Kong Bananza
# build IDs read from the packed 1.8.0 ExeFS (pack_dump.py of updates/917504)
# main imports from all three: subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie, subsdk1 the C library (profile_guess.py on the 1.8.0 ExeFS)
# a file of the 1.8.0 RomFS (the staff roll movie)
# compressed already: zstd archives (.zs, most of the RomFS), BWAV audio (20,991 files), WebM movies (57); and the shader libraries (.metallib), as Donkey Kong Bananza
# The NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap (profile_guess.py). The pool is the Switch 2's 9 GB, as Donkey Kong Bananza's (the Switch 2
# leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB; not measured here): nnMain allocates a fixed 7.04 GB memory block from the heap (main+0xca866c: 0x1c2600000, AllocateMemoryBlock at main+0xbeb454),
# so the Switch 1 pool (3,285 MiB, a 1.68 GB heap) crashed on the null block (main+0x5dd3ac). nninitStartup sizes the heap from the pool: with 9 GB it asks for 7.47 GB (0x1de400000);
# the rest (1.53 GB) it maps into the alias region. The heap check with the 9 GB pool: SetHeapSize OOM: req 0x1de400000 > cap 0x70000000, so an 8 GB heap region. The sdk's address
# region node area takes the alias region's first 1 GB (SDK 21.4.0's AddressRegionManager matches none of sdk_patches.py's node area rules): 1 GB + 1.53 GB fit the 2.75 GB alias region
# 256 MB in front + 2.75 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 8 GB heap region
# the NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (main.npdm META +0x14): IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true
# the RomFS folders whose files hold BNSH (a scan of the 1.8.0 RomFS): Shader/ (six .bfsha.zs and Drive.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.release.sarc.zs), Effect/static.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.esetb.byml.zs,
# 90 Layout/*.blarc.zs; Lib/ (agl, gsys, Terrain, sead: BAHS / sharcb) stays in the group "other"
# agl's render buffer binding wraps its clears in render conditions, as in Donkey Kong Bananza: SetRenderEnableConditional(RENDER_IF_NOT_EQUAL) at main+0x49e194 (1.8.0), then
# ClearColor(index 0, mask 0xf) at main+0x49e1c0. Without the key every clear ran: the title's 3D scene came out black but for a few specks, with only the 2D layout drawn on it
